text:
Devon Li: Quick ping — PR #4682 updates on-prem agent VPC egress rules and moves secret handling to per-tenant KMS envelope. Need security review before we merge tomorrow EOD. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4682

Maria Chen: @Devon Li thanks — will take a look after stand. Quick Q: does this add any external egress to 3rd-party telemetry? :eyes:

Devon Li: no external telemetry. only dedicated egress to customer-owned logging collector (10.1.2.0/24). added ACL in k8s NetworkPolicy and a firewall rule. snippet: ```yaml
# k8s networkpolicy
allow:
  to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.1.2.0/24
```

Samir Patel: pinging @security-bot for key rotation review. Also need to confirm KMS perms for onprem HSM path. I think the PR adds a chart value `KMS_KEY_PATH` to helm chart.

security-bot: Automated check: secret-scan PASSED; kms-policy-check: WARNING — role 'deploy-onprem' lacks 'kms:Decrypt' on resource arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/redwood-onprem. Recommend adding least-priv kms:Decrypt to that role.

Olivia Hart: I'm the rotation runbook owner — if we change key path we must update runbook and secret-rotation Lambda (ticket OPS-1325).

Maria Chen: +1 on the runbook. Also @Samir can we avoid storing raw plaintext in Helm values? Use sealed-secrets or vault-agent; current PR still puts `KMS_KEY_PATH` in values.yaml.

Devon Li: Good catch. I can switch to referencing a Kubernetes secret in namespace `onprem-secrets` and add a SealedSecret CR. Will update the PR.

Samir Patel: After that I can re-run infra-smoke and a staging canary. Can we delay merge by ~2h for my smoke tests? Otherwise we might regress monitors.

Devon Li: fine. target merge window 12:30 PT. Also need approvals from @Maria Chen and @Olivia Hart for security + ops.

Maria Chen: Reviewed a quick pass — left one nit about env var name; lgtm after that.

Olivia Hart: Approved once runbook ticket linked in PR. Add OPS-1325 to PR description.

Devon Li: done — added SealedSecret, updated PR description with OPS-1325, changed env var to `KMS_KEY_REF`. PTAL @Samir @Maria

Samir Patel: running tests now... failing on canary init due to missing service account permission: `iam.serviceAccounts.get` for `onprem-agent-sa`.

Devon Li: Hmm I thought we already added that. Pushed commit to grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` in kustomize overlay. Please retry.

Samir Patel: retry ok now. Canary passed. :tada: I'll request prod rollout after 30m.

security-bot: Manual approval required: security team needs to confirm KMS policy change. @Maria Chen please confirm.

Maria Chen: Approved from security perspective. Confirmed least-priv kms:Decrypt only for deploy-onprem role, sealed secret used. :lock:

Devon Li: thanks — merging in 20. Will watch rollout and postbird for alerts.

sre-bot: Deploy started for pr-4682. Canary: 1/3 pods updated, latency +2ms, error rate 0.0%.

Olivia Hart: tagging OPS-1325 in release notes. followup: schedule key rotation in 30 days.

Devon Li: noted. closing thread, thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
